name: xTool Retail Marker
notes: Galvo laser, same layout as the F1 Ultra: a 1064 nm fiber laser and a 455 nm blue diode.
source: xTool Studio 1.9.11 device extension GS008 (exts/GS008), read 2026-11-26. Work area from processingArea (LASER_PLANE 220 x 220); modules from defaultPower [20, 20] (redPower, laserPower), the labels 455-<W>W / 1064-<W>W and the fiber_ir_blue text key. Which operations each module can do is an assumption.
